Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the liability of certain persons who provide volunteer emergency repairs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to protecting persons who provide volunteeremergency services; and adding a new section to chapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person, including but not limited to contractors, builders,tradespeople, and other providers of construction, remodel, or repairservices, who, without compensation or the expectation of compensation,renders emergency repairs to any structure at the scene of anyaccident, disaster, or emergency that has caused or resulted in damageto the structure is not liable for civil damages resulting from any actor omission in the rendering of such emergency repairs, other than actsor omissions constituting gross negligence or willful or wantonmisconduct. Any person rendering emergency repairs during the courseof regular employment and receiving compensation or expecting toreceive compensation for rendering such repairs is excluded from theprotection of this section. For the purposes of this section, "accident, disaster, or p. 1 HB 1052emergency" includes an earthquake, windstorm, hurricane, landslide,flood, volcanic eruption, explosion, fire, or any similar occurrence.
